assessment_note: MSCA-PF is a unit-cost, single-researcher instrument (selected_call.json: budget_regime='unit_cost', host_country='HU', project_duration_months=30). Per CLAUDE.md §8.1 and §8.4 as amended by C1, the budget-gate source is instrument-conditional: for a unit-cost instrument the sanctioned source is the internal deterministic derivation (unit_cost_budget.json = confirmed_months × published_rates × host_country_coefficient, byte-equal replay-checked), NOT the external Lump Sum Budget Planner. This response_validation invocation therefore evaluates the internal derivation rather than a lump-sum received/ response. The lump-sum received/ directory (containing only .gitkeep, i.e. no external response) is inapplicable for this instrument; the C1 amendment expressly scopes 'absence of a received/ response is a blocking gate failure' to lump-sum instruments only, so its emptiness here is not a blocking gate failure and is documented explicitly rather than silently treated as passing. The categorical Phase-8 block (§8.4) is preserved and instrument-independent, and is satisfied here because every unit_cost_budget.json component — including the host-dependent living-allowance line — resolves to 'Confirmed', with unresolved_components=[] and blocking_inconsistencies=[]. Structural consistency is assessed against the single-researcher work plan and host per §7 Phase 7: the fellowship unit costs fund the fellow at the host executing all five work packages; the instrument carries no per-WP or per-partner budget lines, so per-WP/per-partner absence of a dedicated line is not-applicable rather than a missing-coverage inconsistency. No numeric budget values are materialized into this assessment (Constraint 1 / §8.1 / §8.3): all figures remain solely within unit_cost_budget.json and are referenced only by filename. gate_pass_declaration='pass' is grounded in: (1) the applicable budget is present via the sanctioned internal derivation, (2) it is complete and internally consistent with every component Confirmed, and (3) no unresolved blocking inconsistencies exist.
